dial.summary: Stablecoin dominance fell to ~10.1% as roughly $15B rotated out of stablecoins into crypto, lifting TOTAL market cap to $2.9T while BTC holds near $83,600–84,000 with funding rates at near-zero (0.002%) — confirming spot-driven accumulation over leveraged speculation; twin macro headwinds of DXY at 102.21 and real yields at 2.89% keep the bid contained, with the October 14 CPI print (consensus 3.6–3.7% YoY) as the binary catalyst — a sub-3.0% YoY miss could reprice DXY below 100 and unlock the next BTC leg higher.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) confirmed at $103,649B per StreetStats Oct 9 data; August 2026 is the latest month with all four economies reporting (6–8 week lag); 4-week trend flat — no September G4 aggregate available; YoY growth positive but a confirmed rising 4-week trend is required for supportive status; next G4 M2 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI = 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); New Orders 55.3%, Prices Paid 77.9% (highest since mid-2021); status neutral — above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis; next release November 2, 2026 for October data.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot held at 102.21 through Columbus Day Oct 12, 2026 (Oct 9 close per Trading Economics 102.212, CNBC 102.231; 52-week high 102.54); 4-week trend up from ~99.9 on Sep 9 (+~2.3%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); October 14 CPI print is key repricing catalyst — a miss below 3.0% YoY required for DXY break below 100; next live FX/bond session October 13.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield at 2.89% as of October 9, 2026 (tipsyield.com/streetstats.finance Oct 9 reading; FRED DFII10 confirmed 2.87% for Oct 8; Columbus Day Oct 12 — next FRED update Oct 13); 4-week trend up from ~2.52% on Sep 9 (+~37bps); status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and above 2% threshold); October 14 CPI is the key repricing catalyst.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 9, 2026: 10Y at 5.24%, 2Y at 4.80% → spread = +44bps (FRED T10Y2Y confirmed 0.44 for Oct 9; next release Oct 13; Columbus Day Oct 12); 4-week trend up (steepening from ~+42bps on Sep 9 to +44bps = +2bps over 4 weeks); status supportive (positive and steepening); FOMC Oct 27–28 and Oct 14 CPI are the next major curve catalysts.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,747,560M ($6.748T) for week ending October 7, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 8; next release Oct 15 covering week ending Oct 14); 4-week trend flat: Sep 9 ~$6,737B → Oct 7 $6,748B = +$11B (+0.16%); status supportive (flat at post-2022 QT-pause stabilization plateau, no QT acceleration).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Glassnode cross-exchange OI-weighted 8h avg at 0.002% as of Oct 9–12, 2026 (Coinglass live page unreachable); down from MacroMicro Sep 30 cross-exchange avg of 0.0067%, confirming 30-day downtrend; BTC near $83,600–84,000 (CoinDesk/CoinGecko Oct 12) with Fear & Greed at 69; status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold — confirms spot-driven accumulation, not leveraged speculation).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$292.3B vs total crypto ~$2.9T (CoinGabbar/CoinGecko Oct 12, 2026) = 10.1% dominance; 30-day trend down: ~10.5% (Sep 12) → 10.1% (Oct 12) = −0.4pp; ~$15B rotated out of stablecoins while total market cap rose ~$90B — active capital rotation into crypto; BTC.D at ~58% (CoinGabbar Oct 12); status supportive (falling on 30-day basis while total market cap rises).

upcoming.title: CPI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Consumer Price Index for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — consensus forecast: headline 3.6–3.7% YoY (vs August 3.4%), core CPI ~2.4%; ISM Manufacturing Prices Paid at 77.9% is a leading upside signal; a hot print at or above consensus would reinforce October 27–28 FOMC hike odds and push DXY toward 104, while a miss below 3.0% YoY would cement Fed hold expectations and could catalyze a BTC breakout above $85K resistance.

upcoming.title: Fed Beige Book (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Beige Book released at 2:00 PM ET — qualitative survey of economic conditions across the 12 Fed districts; released two weeks before the October 27–28 FOMC meeting; with ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and Prices Paid elevated at 77.9%, any Beige Book language reinforcing broad-based price pressures or tight labor markets would keep October hike odds elevated.

upcoming.title: PPI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Producer Price Index for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — pipeline inflation released the day after CPI; a hot PPI print following a hot CPI would reinforce October hike expectations and likely push DXY back toward 104; ISM Manufacturing Prices Paid at 77.9% is a leading upside signal for producer prices.

upcoming.title: Retail Sales (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau Retail Sales for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — following the September NFP shock (+29K), a weak retail sales print would confirm broad consumer softening and reinforce Fed hold narrative; a strong print alongside weak labor extends the late-cycle bifurcation signal; provides key pre-FOMC context on Q3 consumer demand ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 11, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 11, 2026 — released alongside September PPI and Retail Sales; claims trajectory directly informs market odds for a Fed pause vs. hike at the October 27–28 meeting; a print above 200K would reinforce labor market softening following the September NFP shock of +29K.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ended October 14, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve H.4.1 weekly balance sheet release at 4:30 PM ET — covers week ending October 14, 2026; prior reading $6,747,560M ($6.748T, week ending Oct 7); four consecutive weeks of flat-to-marginal expansion; a shift toward contraction combined with rising overnight rates would flip status from supportive to headwind.

upcoming.title: Industrial Production & Capacity Utilization (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Board releases September 2026 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization at 9:15 AM ET; completes the Q3 output picture ahead of the GDP advance estimate (October 29); September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and Production Index at 56.7% suggest solid output growth; a miss would reinforce stagflation risk narrative (hot prices, softening activity) into the October 27–28 FOMC.
